item.title: Kiwanis Christmas campaign distributes $34K to Pembroke food programs
item.description: The proceeds from the Kiwanis Club of Pembroke’s 2025 Christmas Toy and Food Drive are now being put to work across the city, with $34,000 distributed to four local organizations providing food and meal programs for residents in need. item.title: Deep River Symphony Orchestra presents mucial moods and storytelling
item.description: Pembroke native Brandon Wilkie is the cello soloist in the Deep River Symphony Orchestra’s upcoming concert on Feb. 28. Wilkie will perform Robert Schumann’s Cello Concerto in A minor which evokes moods ranging from passion and melancholy to desperation and optimism. The concert will also feature well-known in Pembroke area musical theatre performer Sean Keels […]
